KEY TAKEAWAYS
Room to grow from the $400s:

Slab and basement homesites available:
Sierra Brooke offers flexible price points with a mix of slab and basement homesites.
Designed with flex space:
Every floor plan at Sierra Brooke includes a main-floor study and an upstairs loft.
Assigned to Dacula Cluster schools:
Homes at Sierra Brooke are assigned to Alcova Elementary, Dacula Middle and Dacula High in Gwinnett County Public Schools.

The public celebration at Sierra Brooke will run from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m., featuring food, refreshments, a raffle and Grand Opening savings. The event will follow an agent preview event on Nov. 12.
LAWRENCEVILLE, Ga., Nov. 11, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Century Communities, Inc. (

)—a top national homebuilder, industry leader in online home sales, and featured on America's Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek—will celebrate the Grand Opening of Sierra Brooke on Saturday, Nov. 14, bringing new single-family homes with up to 5 bedrooms to Lawrenceville, GA, from $439,990. Two-story floor plans at the community range from 2,400 to 2,774 square feet, and buyers will be able to choose between slab and basement homesites.
Learn more, join the interest list, and RSVP for the Grand Opening at

"Sierra Brooke is built around providing Gwinnett County buyers with more home for their budget, with homes from the $400s offering up to 5 bedrooms, on slab or basement homesites, in a great location with quick access to Dacula Cluster schools," said Tom Bowers, Atlanta Division President. "With limited homesites available, the Grand Opening is the perfect chance to come out, tour our Atlas model home, and work with our team to find your best fit."

The Grand Opening event will offer model home tours, complimentary food, limited-time savings opportunities, and the chance to win take-home prizes. Ahead of the public celebration, the Company will host a preview event and ribbon-cutting for real estate agents on Thursday, Nov. 12, with a first look at the community, refreshments and a raffle.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Question:
What county is Sierra Brooke in Lawrenceville, GA, located in?
Answer:
Sierra Brooke is located in Gwinnett County, at 352 Sweetgum Road in Lawrenceville, GA 30045.
Question:
How much do new homes at Sierra Brooke in Lawrenceville, GA, cost?
Answer:
New homes at Sierra Brooke are priced from the $400s, with two-story floor plans ranging from 2,400 to 2,774 square feet and featuring 2-car garages.
Question:
What schools are assigned to Sierra Brooke?
Answer:
Sierra Brooke in Lawrenceville, GA, is assigned to Alcova Elementary, Dacula Middle and Dacula High, which make up the Dacula Cluster of Gwinnett County Public Schools.
Question:
Does Sierra Brooke offer homes with basements?
Answer:
Yes. Sierra Brooke in Lawrenceville, GA, offers both slab and basement homesites.
Question:
When is Sierra Brooke's Grand Opening?
Answer:
Sierra Brooke's Grand Opening in Lawrenceville, GA, is Saturday, Nov. 14, 2026, from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m. The public event includes food, refreshments, a raffle and Grand Opening savings.
